_why: E04: same recipe as E01, trained on Haiku labels (rubric v1.4-1.6, 1,720 train / 200 val) instead of 3,687 heuristic labels. Haiku agrees with gold on ~94-100% of moves vs the heuristic's 61%: if the student copies its teacher, this should lift gold accuracy most for balanced, real estate and business sims, with less than half the data.
